description: React component for the Data Retention Settings page in Mattermost admin console, managing global and custom retention policies, including job scheduling and policy management.

classes.name: DataRetentionSettings
classes.description: React component class for managing data retention policies in the admin console.

methods.name: deleteCustomPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a custom data retention policy by ID and reloads the first page.

methods.name: getGlobalPolicyColumns
methods.description: Returns column definitions for the global policies data grid.

methods.name: getCustomPolicyColumns
methods.description: Returns column definitions for the custom policies data grid.

methods.name: getGlobalRetentionSetting
methods.description: Returns JSX element displaying the global retention setting based on enabled status and hours.

methods.name: getMessageRetentionSetting
methods.description: Returns JSX element displaying message retention duration based on enabled status and days.

methods.name: getGlobalPolicyRows
methods.description: Returns rows for the global policies data grid.

methods.name: getChannelAndTeamCounts
methods.description: Returns JSX element with counts of channels and teams for a policy.

methods.name: getCustomPolicyRows
methods.description: Returns rows for the custom policies data grid.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of custom policies.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data load when component mounts.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of custom policies.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of custom policies.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination start/end counts and total.

methods.name: showEditJobTime
methods.description: Sets state to show or hide job time editing UI.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Focuses input when showEditJobTime state changes to true.

methods.name: handleCreateJob
methods.description: Creates a new data retention job and refreshes job list.

methods.name: changeJobTimeConfig
methods.description: Updates the job start time configuration.

methods.name: getJobStartTime
methods.description: Returns formatted JSX for the scheduled job start time.

methods.name: getJobTimeOptions
methods.description: Generates options for selecting job start times.
